query.sql:
-- One reading per second for a minute, as JSON lines.
for i = 1, 60 do
  print(vim.json.encode({ at = os.date("%H:%M:%S"), load = 40 + math.random(0, 30) }))
  dbdash.sleep(1000)
end

query.sql:
-- Count the lines of a file in cwd, written as items separated by ";".
local n = 0
for _ in io.lines("events.schema.yaml") do n = n + 1 end
io.write("lines=" .. n .. ";")
io.write("dir=" .. dbdash.cwd .. ";")
-- dbdash.emit: one item as it is, no cutting (the last item: the code ends).
dbdash.emit({ { key = "done", value = os.date("%H:%M:%S") } })

show.title: io.write() with a delimiter, dbdash.emit(), cwd
